references.name: Three-Phase Voltage-Sourced Converter (SPWM)
references.model_version: R2025a; native MATLAB R2025a Update 1 run
references.mathematical_compatibility: Native MATLAB enumeration ee.enum.converters.switchingdevice resolves device_type=1 to GTO (gto=1, ideal=2, igbt=3), with active switch Ron=0.001ohm and Vf=0.6V, plus enabled protection diode (diode_Vf=0.8V, diode_Ron=0.001ohm, diode_Goff=1e-5S). Converter.Q1.ideal_switch in native simlog is an internal device implementation, not evidence of the top-level ideal-switch variant; static TypeOptions position is also insufficient. Actual DC side is 100V, series R0.1ohm, shunt C5000uF; each phase filter structure=2 is L-only 500uH, load structure=1 is R-only 1ohm (load L200uH mask value inactive). Six gate controls apply offsets to both sine and carrier and include both-off intervals, requiring automatic diode current paths; not identical to PyCy example12 complementary digital PWM.
blockers: Existing example12 is a gate generator with no electrical network; default official output currents cannot alone validate it.

Six offset gate controls include both-off intervals and automatic protection diode commutation, while PyCy externally controlled complementary switches do not implement automatic diode state selection.
Define legitimate topology, source, active mask and gate-sequence mapping before choosing this source for a formal SPWM comparison.

Native enumeration resolves device_type=3 to IGBT with active Vf=0.8V, Ron=0.001ohm and Goff=1e-5S; enabled no-dynamics antiparallel diodes have the same Vf/Ron/Goff. Logged Q1/Q2, Q3/Q4, Q5/Q6 map A/B/C upper/lower gates and are strictly complementary. Official Natural PWM computes switching times; example12 uses pointwise sampled carrier comparison. IGBT forward drop, unidirectional device conduction and automatic diode current paths differ from PyCy bilateral Ron/Goff switches. No fitted time/amplitude adjustment. Resource data readiness does not imply PyCy validation passed.

Gate-sequence differences and IGBT/diode physical differences have not been isolated; do not claim device equivalence or automatically commutating diode validation.

references.name: Transmission Line (finite 50-T RLCG ladder)
references.model_version: Original SLX metadata R2025a; executed in MATLAB 25.1.0.2973910 (R2025a) Update 1
dependencies: Installed TransmissionLine_lib.slx and TransmissionLine.t_section source from Simscape example_libraries; exact hashes recorded in provenance.
references.mathematical_compatibility: Original finite 50-cell symmetric RLCG T ladder, 5m total. Each T has two series half-R/half-L arms and a middle shunt G/C, no semiconductors. All voltages reference common n=0. Source is ideal 10V peak, 200MHz sine; termination is 50ohm. Actual model PreLoadFcn overrides generic library defaults. Reference/solver changes are explicit, no electrical/controller/topology changes. This is not a Bergeron model, pi ladder, pure propagation-delay model or exact distributed cable reference.
references.solver_change_scope: Default daessc/0.5ns-max-step probe retained separately. Formal reference applies ode15s 10ps/5ps and logging overrides through SimulationInput; explicitly binds the seven inspected original default workspace variables (length=5, nSegments=50, segmentLength=0.1, R=0.0067, C=1e-10, Z=50, G=5e-6) to prevent loaded-workspace contamination. Original electrical parameters/topology and SLX remain unchanged. Loaded model and same-named TransmissionLine_lib must resolve to inspected canonical paths, match hashes and have Dirty=off. Guarded re-export retained identical canonical/refined CSV bytes.
references.signal_direction: Source to first line section; output line to 50-ohm load.
